usedFor: Browse AI finishes scraping tasks and Memory stores values by key, with “Table Export” feeding the “Memory” action.

bestTemplate.name: “Table Export” in Browse AI, then “Memory” in Memory
bestTemplate.why: A successful export saves the scraped values under a key you can look up later.

watchOut: “Delete Records” in Memory removes workspace records, so check which trigger feeds it before turning it on.
